headline: UK House Asking Prices Drop 1.8% as High Mortgage Costs Squeeze Buyers
summary: British residential asking prices dropped 1.8% month-on-month in the four weeks to November 7, exceeding the seasonal average 1.1% decline over the past decade as high mortgage rates suppress demand.
why: UK house prices reflect consumer borrowing capacity and monetary policy transmission through the domestic banking sector.

impacts.name: UK Homebuilders
impacts.why: A 1.8% monthly slide in asking prices reflects persistent buyer affordability headwinds and pressure on developer margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
